SELECT e.*, w.name AS work_center_name FROM mes_equipment e LEFT JOIN mes_work_center w ON w.id = e.work_center_id
(e.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND e.status = #{status} AND e.work_center_id = #{workCenterId} AND e.next_maintain_date <= #{dueBefore} AND e.status <> 'SCRAPPED'
ORDER BY e.next_maintain_date, e.code
